# Naath Industries Pvt. Ltd.

> Naath Industries Pvt. Ltd. is an indenting house established in 1982, based in India. We connect Indian buyers with reputed suppliers around the world — we do not manufacture or recycle material ourselves, we broker and indent the trade between global suppliers and Indian importers.

## What we trade
- Used clothing and mixed rags for the textile recycling industry (recovered garments, sorted and baled at origin, for shoddy yarns, blankets, wipers and regenerated fabric)
- Raw wool and wool wastes (greasy and scoured wool, noils, laps and hard wastes) for Indian spinners and woollen mills
- Synthetic fibre wastes (acrylic and other synthetic wastes) for regeneration into new yarns

## Who we serve
Indian buyers (spinners, mills, recyclers) sourcing from reputed global suppliers via container shipment / import trade. We represent suppliers and match them with buyers, handling introductions, negotiation and follow-through.

## Key facts
- Founded: 1982
- Type: Indenting house / import-export trade intermediary (not a manufacturer or recycler)
- Location: India
